"""Run run.sh as a subprocess with resource measurements."""
import json, os, resource, subprocess, sys, time

data = open(sys.argv[1], 'rb').read()
t0 = time.time()
c0 = time.process_time()
proc = subprocess.run(['/workspace/submission/run.sh'], input=data,
                      capture_output=True, cwd='/')
wall = time.time() - t0
usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('exit=%d wall=%.2fs cpu_user=%.2fs cpu_sys=%.2fs maxrss=%.1f MiB'
      % (proc.returncode, wall, usage.ru_utime, usage.ru_stime, usage.ru_maxrss / 1024.0))
print('stderr:', proc.stderr.decode()[:500])
out_lines = proc.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print('output lines:', len(out_lines))
for line in out_lines:
    obj = json.loads(line)
    print('  ', obj.get('id'), obj.get('status'), obj.get('min_faults'),
          'error' if 'error' in obj else '')
PYEOF
